text:
Priya Nair: dropping the latest compact history + rollforward mock. key asks: rollforward affordance (not just rollback), colorblind palette for variant lanes, and SR text for the timeline scrubber. feedback please. https://www.figma.com/file/abc/rollforward-panel
Ethan Liu: nice work. one accessibility-first nit: the current variant lane colors use red/orange/green which is hard for deuteranopes. can we use patterned outlines or distinguishable hues + labels?
Marco Rossi: +1. also suggest adding a small textual prefix on each lane like "A", "B" for quick recognition. could be visually-hidden but visible in compact.
Lena Ortiz: on rollforward: product wants both "Rollback" and "Roll forward to next" flows. how do we present this in the timeline?
Priya Nair: idea: context menu on each checkpoint with actions: "Roll back to this" and "Roll forward from this" (if there is a later checkpoint). show disabled state when not applicable.
Ethan Liu: keyboard: ensure the menu is reachable from focused checkpoint and menu items are `role=menuitem` with clear aria-labels. avoid ambiguous labels like "Go".
Marco Rossi: microinteraction: when user hovers or focuses a checkpoint, show a 150ms fade for the popup. want to avoid flicker on quick scrubs.
Lena Ortiz: related copy question: snapshot names are autogenerated like `snapshot-20260312-1`. PMs want more human-friendly names in UI: e.g., "Canary: March 12". Should we show both?
Priya Nair: plan: display friendly label by default and full slug on hover/focus. store full slug in metadata and show in flyout.
Design Bot: visual-regression: rollforward-toolbar-hover-delay decreased to 120ms 12; regression passed on contrast checks.
ContrastBot: auto-check: new palette meets 3:1 for variant labels and 4.5:1 for active pill border. recommendation: increase border thickness from 1px to 2px at 320px width.
Ethan Liu: tiny CSS nit: active pill border increase looks good but pushes layout. add `box-sizing: border-box` and reduce inner padding by 2px.
Marco Rossi: ARIA text draft for scrubber changes. proposing we announce minimal phrase:
```
"Timeline: March 12, 2026 1212 12 staged 15% -> variant B"
"Timeline: March 11, 2026 12 rolled back to v2.4"
"Timeline: March 10, 2026 12 rollforward available to v3.0"
```
Lena Ortiz: small tweak: include state token at the end: "(canary)", "(reverted)" so SR users get quick status.
Priya Nair: updated ARIA examples to be shorter and include state token. good call.
Ethan Liu: question: when user triggers rollforward, do we show an undo affordance? UX research says users expect ephemeral undo even after rollforward.
Marco Rossi: yes - show a banner: "Rolled forward to v3.0. Undo" with 30s countdown. make Undo button `aria-live` polite so SR users are aware.
Lena Ortiz: confirm modal copy: title "Confirm roll forward" body "This will make version v3.0 live. Audit note (optional): [textarea]" primary button "Roll forward" secondary "Cancel". good?
Priya Nair: sounds good. also add a short help link in modal: "When to roll forward vs rollback" linking to docs.
Design Bot: accessibility check: modal uses `role=dialog` with `aria-modal=true` and focus trap verified.
ContrastBot: final check: ensure keyboard focus ring is 3px offset to meet focus contrast for the new palette.
Ethan Liu: one more mobile note: compact history should collapse to a vertical stacked list on <360px, with touch-friendly targets (min 44px). test on android.
Priya Nair: will update frames and push a new preview. tagging @Marco @Lena for final signoff.
DeployBot: preview for branch `rollforward-ux` deployed at sha def456 12 preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/rollforward-ux
Marco Rossi: preview looks good on iOS Safari. leaving a couple inline comments in Figma. :+1:
